info.event: Flood Alert: South East Somerset Rivers, Upper Reaches
info.headline: Flooding is possible: South East Somerset Rivers, Upper Reaches
info.description:
Rising river levels this evening may lead to flooding. Flooding is possible on Saturday 28 November .
Following heavy rain today, Saturday 28 November 2026, flooding is forecast to affect locations near the River Yeo, River Cam, River Wriggle, with low lying land and roads to be most affected, particularly around the Sparkford to Weston Bampfylde road and Deep Ford Lane, Chetnole. The main band of rain has passed out of the area, leaving drier weather overnight and tomorrow, Sunday. River levels should begin to drop overnight and into tomorrow. Further rain is forecast later on Monday, through Tuesday and Wednesday, which will cause rivers to rise again and potentially trigger further alerts.
We are closely monitoring the situation . We are checking rivers, defences and screens for blockages.
Avoid using low lying footpaths and any bridges near local watercourses. . Refer to the local authority website for road closures.
This message will be updated by 12:00AM on Sunday 29 November or as the situation changes.
info.instruction:
Be prepared
You should: - go to Check for flooding for a map of the area and to monitor up-to-date local flood information – https://check-for-flooding.service.gov.uk/target-area/112WAFTSES - get ready to act on your personal flood plan if you have one - https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/personal-flood-plan - follow the guidance in 'What to do before or during a flood' - https://www.gov.uk/help-during-flood
You can also read more about what flood alerts are – https://www.gov.uk/guidance/flood-alerts-and-warnings-what-they-are-and-what-to-do#flood-alert
Stay up to date
To get the latest flood information, you can: - go to Check for flooding - monitor local weather, news and travel updates - call Floodline on 0345 988 1188, using quickdial code 210010
